primary_hypothesis: One frozen autonomous discovery system can use generic experience learned before holdout access to causally improve verified discovery success on genuinely unseen unrelated algorithmic tasks under equal resource budgets.
claim_boundary: The primary claim is empirical capability, not architectural novelty. Established retrieval, evolution, synthesis, verification, reformulation and learned-guidance components may be used as infrastructure. Passing internal gates is not a world breakthrough without external novelty and independent reproduction.

control_arms.fvd_full: Frozen engine with frozen learned experience artifact.
control_arms.fvd_no_experience: Same engine and equal budgets with learned experience physically removed or zeroed.
control_arms.fvd_shuffled_experience: Same artifact interface/size but reusable-state semantics or task-to-experience associations deterministically permuted where meaningful.
control_arms.retrieval_only: Retrieval from the same apprenticeship corpus without the full learned controller or abstraction machinery.
control_arms.evolution_only: Generic evaluator-guided evolutionary search under the same evaluator budget.
control_arms.predecessor_v7: Frozen predecessor comparison where technically applicable.

causal_transfer_win_all_required: full produces an independently verified qualifying result
no_experience fails the native gate or is materially worse under the preregistered equal-budget criterion
shuffled_experience does not explain the gain
at least one nontrivial learned artifact element used by full has provenance from a different apprenticeship task family
exact removal or permutation replay removes the qualifying advantage
retrieval_only does not match within frozen budget
evolution_only does not match within frozen budget
all proposal and evaluation logs respect the holdout access boundary
external_frontier_gate_all_required_afte: at least one objectively new independently verifiable frontier result, preferably two unrelated results
novelty relative to the frozen literature and data snapshot
same frozen FVD engine with no frontier-specific rescue branch
causal dependence on pre-frontier learned experience under clean ablation/control
independent clean-room reproduction in a separate implementation or environment
inspectable evidence sufficient for third-party verification
development_plumbing_gates: same task-independent engine interface handles all selected development families
every candidate receives independent correctness verification
no_experience and shuffled_experience controls are physically effective
budget accounting is exact and auditable
hidden task data is inaccessible before commit barrier
failed scientific gate processes propagate nonzero exit status to CI
result artifacts record hashes, seeds and allowed randomness
hard_kill_rules: Any missing required internal campaign conjunct means campaign failure.
Do not reinterpret partial causal wins as a campaign pass.
Do not modify the failed R3 IPWM route or open its blocked real intervention corpus as part of this pivot.
Do not create task-specific rescue branches after hidden result access.
Do not make a world-breakthrough claim before the external frontier and independent reproduction gates pass.
